from flask import Flask
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask_admin import Admin
from flask_admin.contrib.sqla import ModelView
from flask_admin.contrib.sqla.validators import ItemsRequired
app=Flask(__name__); app.config.update(SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI='sqlite://',SECRET_KEY='x',WTF_CSRF_ENABLED=False)
db=SQLAlchemy(app)
assoc=db.Table('assoc',db.Column('post_id',db.ForeignKey('post.id')),db.Column('tag_id',db.ForeignKey('tag.id')))
class Tag(db.Model):
    id=db.Column(db.Integer,primary_key=True); name=db.Column(db.String)
    def __str__(self): return self.name
class Post(db.Model):
    id=db.Column(db.Integer,primary_key=True); title=db.Column(db.String)
    tags=db.relationship(Tag,secondary=assoc)
class Comment(db.Model):
    id=db.Column(db.Integer,primary_key=True); text=db.Column(db.String)
    post_id=db.Column(db.ForeignKey('post.id')); post=db.relationship(Post,backref='comments')
class PV(ModelView):
    form_args={'tags':{'validators':[ItemsRequired()]},'comments':{'validators':[ItemsRequired()]}}
    inline_models=(Comment,)
class PV2(ModelView):
    form_args={'tags':{'validators':[ItemsRequired(min=2)]}}
    form_ajax_refs={'tags':{'fields':['name']}}
admin=Admin(app)
admin.add_view(PV(Post,db.session)); admin.add_view(PV2(Post,db.session,endpoint='p2'))
with app.app_context():
    db.create_all(); db.session.add_all([Tag(name='a'),Tag(name='b')]); db.session.commit()
c=app.test_client()
def post(url,data,label):
    r=c.post(url,data=data,follow_redirects=False)
    body=r.get_data(as_text=True)
    import re
    errs=re.findall(r'At least[^<]*',body)
    with app.app_context(): n=Post.query.count()
    print(f'{label}: status={r.status_code} errors={errs} posts={n}')
    return r
post('/admin/post/new/',{'title':'t'},'m2m none, inline none')
post('/admin/post/new/',{'title':'t','tags':['1']},'m2m 1, inline none')
post('/admin/post/new/',{'title':'t','tags':['1'],'comments-0-text':'hi'},'m2m 1, inline 1')
with app.app_context(): pid=Post.query.first().id; cid=Comment.query.first().id
post(f'/admin/post/edit/?id={pid}',{'title':'t','tags':['1'],'comments-0-id':str(cid),'comments-0-text':'hi','del-comments-0':'y'},'edit: delete only inline')
post(f'/admin/post/edit/?id={pid}',{'title':'t','tags':['1','2'],'comments-0-id':str(cid),'comments-0-text':'hi2'},'edit: keep inline')
post('/admin/p2/new/',{'title':'t','tags':'1'},'ajax min2 one')
post('/admin/p2/new/',{'title':'t','tags':'1,2'},'ajax min2 two')
EOF

The code in this repo works. I ran full admin create and edit saves through a real Flask app, and every case behaves correctly:

| Save | Result |
|---|---|
| No tags, no inline comments | Rejected, "At least 1 item is required" on both fields |
| 1 tag, no comments | Rejected on comments only |
| 1 tag, 1 comment | Saved |
| Edit: delete the only comment | Rejected (entries marked for deletion aren't counted) |
| Edit: keep the comment, 2 tags | Saved |
| AJAX multi-select, `min=2`, 1 tag | Rejected, "At least 2 items are required" |
| AJAX multi-select, 2 tags | Saved |

No crashes, and the messages show the real number.

So your app almost certainly isn't running this code. Line 100 in your traceback only exists in the old version. No Python environment on this machine has flask_admin installed, so your app imports it from whatever folder it runs in or has on its path. There are several old copies under `exp1-work` (`variants/fa-bug`, the `runs/*/orig` folders) that still have the crashing code.
